spans.s:
n. (-सं)
The code, &c. of UŚANAS.
E.
उशनस्, and अण् aff.

n. (-णं)
Pungency.
E.
उषण pepper, &c. अण affix; also उषण.

n. (-धं)
A medicament, a drug, any herb, mineral, &c. used in medicine.
E.
औषधि an annual plant, and अण् aff.

n. (-धिः)
A deciduous plant, an annual as grass, &c.
E.
see औषधि.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Medicinal.
E.
औषध, and छ aff.

n. (-रं)
1 Fossile salt.
2 Iron stone.
E.
ऊषरा desert soil, अण् affix; also with कन् added औषरक.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Early, matutinal.
E.
उषस् the dawn, अण् aff.
